place.name: Storulvån Mountain Lodge
place.description: Storulvån Mountain Lodge (Swedish: Storulvåns fjällstation) is a mountain station in Undersåker parish, Åre Municipality in Jämtland County in western Sweden, belonging to the Swedish Tourist Association (STF). The first building was erected in 1900 as a rest station on the path from Handöl to Sylarna.
